condition_id_rule: CSP-Vnn maps to specification Ann. Primary IDs remain stable.

E01.result: Current static docs work without console credentials. Typography, anchors, contrast, and 320 px reflow pass. Dynamic deployment data remains protected.

E02.result: Current-release README follows install, catalog without keys, provider access, and real inference. Every advertised method has native evidence. Disclose current persistent development overrides and remove them from the recorded process environment. Qualify or remove latency claims that rely only on the controller benchmark.

E03.result: Current-release demo proves the first-use sequence with artifact identity, real inference, readable media, and transcript. Preserve real inference timing and disclose other cuts.

qualification.missing_environment_or_test_matches: UNVERIFIED. Required subcases fail their parent case.
qualification.task_scope: Task checks prove their named subcases. A full primary case needs all its required subcases for the current release profile.

task_notes.CSP7: Run Starmap resolver subcases. Starport completes the cross-product case in CSP9.
task_notes.CSP20: Install candidate archives and test current advertised installers. CSP24 completes final released-installer evidence.
task_notes.CSP21: Candidate rehearsal and recording tooling only. Final capture after release belongs to CSP24.
task_notes.CSP22: Require 43 complete primary cases plus eight locally executable subcases against the exact final candidate. Seven incomplete parent cases remain UNVERIFIED until publication.
task_notes.CSP24: All 50 primary cases need current released-artifact evidence. Artifact or behavior changes invalidate affected performance profiles.
task_notes.CSP12.1: Own cache isolation, expiry, nonblocking fills, and bounded streaming. CSP15 repeats real shared-cache failure evidence.
task_notes.CSP0.4: Establish full-path measurements and a reviewed numeric profile before optimization. Partial baseline checks cannot qualify A50.
task_notes.CSP3.1: Own Starmap offering lookup and caller ownership. Starport completes A44 through CSP10.1 after a compatible dependency release.
task_notes.CSP9.1: Extend managed material to account and shared credentials without weakening encryption or grant checks.
task_notes.CSP10.1: Own static candidates and generation indexes. Dynamic authorization and advisory health retain separate owners.
task_notes.CSP10.2: Own bounded authorization records and validity. Applied configuration memory remains with CSP16.
task_notes.CSP10.3: Own background advisory exchange and local callback behavior. Authority and admission are separate.
task_notes.CSP12.2: Own atomic per-attempt reservation and uncertain-capacity recovery. Optional local quota leases require the same contract or explicit unsupported status.
task_notes.CSP1: Publish the shared settings contract and standalone descriptor reference. ER01 leaves cross-product primary-file selection, bootstrap location, and generated path inventory under their existing CSP8 gate after CSP2 path implementation.

R01.result: Recording tooling produces an identified candidate rehearsal with disclosed fixtures, cuts, artifact hashes, and an uncut source. It cannot qualify final release cases.

R02.result: Candidate media passes dimension, size, link, poster, transcript, and human readability checks. Product or installer changes invalidate this rehearsal.

subcase_contracts.A03.starmap_file_manifest: All applicable Starmap files match specification 4.2 and report permissions, ownership, lifetime, and recovery treatment.
subcase_contracts.A03.starport_file_manifest: All applicable Starport files match specification 4.2, including tokens, database sidecars, blobs, and runtime evidence.
subcase_contracts.A03.root_leaf_precedence: Absolute root overrides and configuration-root-relative leaf overrides resolve consistently without working-directory dependence.
subcase_contracts.A03.relative_anchor_migration_guard: An unknown previous anchor refuses migration until the operator supplies an absolute path.
subcase_contracts.A03.required_empty_path_refusal: Persistent startup rejects empty required database and runtime paths before opening an in-memory store.
subcase_contracts.A03.effective_path_report: CLI text and JSON show actual overrides rather than default paths, without creating files during inspection.
subcase_contracts.A03.two_instances_same_user: Distinct instance IDs under one user resolve different runtime directories and seeds.
subcase_contracts.A03.duplicate_owner_refusal: A duplicate local runtime path refuses startup without changing the original instance state. Shared active identity checks also run in A13.
subcase_contracts.A03.service_container_roots: Service and container profiles resolve the exact declared roots independently of the process home directory.
subcase_contracts.A03.shared_backend_no_local_databases: A shared recipe creates required local bootstrap/runtime artifacts but no unused Badger or SQLite database.
subcase_contracts.A04.identity_and_journal_recovery: Interrupted migration preserves ownership, seed, journals, encryption access, and the previous complete installation.
subcase_contracts.A24.starmap_yaml_parity: Every supported catalog descriptor accepts equivalent YAML, flag, and environment input.
subcase_contracts.A24.dotenv_conflict_migration: Explicit dotenv loading preserves process values and applies local-file precedence with redacted upgrade conflicts.
subcase_contracts.A24.primary_config_file_selection: Starmap selects config.yaml and Starport selects config.env without alternate-format or cross-product searches.
subcase_contracts.A24.bootstrap_file_location: A value inside a configuration file cannot relocate the file selected before parsing.
subcase_contracts.A24.generated_file_inventory: Generated reference files agree with the runtime path and storage descriptor inventory.
subcase_contracts.A16.complete_backup_manifest: A consistent backup manifest binds KV, SQL, blobs, authority evidence, and required secret recovery access.
subcase_contracts.A31.container_recreation_records: Authenticated API checks recover linked KV, SQL, and blob records after application container removal and recreation.
subcase_contracts.A31.readonly_container_mounts: A read-only image runs with only its declared writable mounts and persists every required local artifact.
subcase_contracts.A31.compose_complete_storage: The shipped Compose recipe declares a complete supported storage topology and passes recreation and restore checks.
subcase_contracts.A34.persistence_paths_and_cache_roles: README setup identifies actual persistent paths, temporary exceptions, and database-versus-cache roles without obscuring first use.
subcase_contracts.A41.valkey_url_contract: Accepted URI forms parse correctly. Malformed input and conflicting credential sources fail before data access.
subcase_contracts.A41.valkey_tls_identity: Real TLS verifies CA and hostname. Invalid certificates and downgrade attempts fail.
subcase_contracts.A41.valkey_username_password: Real service authentication accepts the declared credential forms and redacts all failure diagnostics.
subcase_contracts.A41.valkey_effective_connection_options: Supported limits and timeout settings affect the actual client. Unsupported options fail explicitly.
subcase_contracts.A41.badger_effective_options: Compression, GC interval, discard ratio, and supported memory settings affect the actual engine behavior.
subcase_contracts.A41.badger_write_sync_profile: Disk-backed and memory modes remain distinct. Synchronous production writes and upgrade diagnostics match the declared durability profile.
subcase_contracts.A41.deployment_key_channel_isolation: Product operations for two deployments on one test service cannot read, overwrite, subscribe to, or commit each other's scoped records.
subcase_contracts.A41.namespace_atomic_layout: All multi-key operations use the declared deployment prefix and compatible hash slots.
subcase_contracts.A41.unprefixed_record_migration: An interrupted namespace migration preserves all durable records and references without dual authority.
subcase_contracts.A41.unsupported_modes_refused: Unsupported endpoint forms and backend modes return explicit errors and cannot receive support credit.
subcase_contracts.A42.memory_and_shared_cache_selection: Primary memory caches and any declared dedicated shared cache use cache-owned storage, separate from durable KV.
subcase_contracts.A42.expiry_preserving_refill: Local refill expires no later than the backing record, including repeated refill and exact-boundary cases.
subcase_contracts.A42.unknown_remaining_ttl: A backing result without trustworthy remaining lifetime never receives an extended local refill.
subcase_contracts.A42.capacity_and_entry_limits: Configured byte, entry, and TTL limits apply under pressure without deleting durable records.
subcase_contracts.A42.cache_only_cleanup: Cleanup removes only the selected cache data and leaves catalog, account, credential, budget, and usage records intact.
subcase_contracts.A42.cache_outage_admission: Cache failure produces a miss while current permission and budget rules still govern inference.
subcase_contracts.A42.generation_account_scope: Projection invalidation follows catalog generations. Response and extraction data remain isolated by required account and policy scope.
subcase_contracts.A42.enablement_by_cache_kind: Response, projection, extraction, and optional semantic controls follow their documented enablement and cost behavior.
subcase_contracts.A42.memory_budget_measurement: The recipe records configured capacities separately from measured process memory at the declared workload.
subcase_contracts.A43.memory_databases: Default development uses memory Badger and SQLite and loses records across a fresh process.
subcase_contracts.A43.scratch_blobs_runtime: Blob and catalog runtime files live under one private uniquely owned temporary root.
subcase_contracts.A43.persistent_selectors_rejected: Persistent KV, SQL, object-store, and catalog-state inputs fail before connections or persistent writes.
subcase_contracts.A43.persistent_installation_untouched: Development does not create or rotate persistent tokens or change existing installation records.
subcase_contracts.A43.normal_shutdown_cleanup: Normal close removes owned scratch files without touching operator directories.
subcase_contracts.A43.crash_cleanup_ownership: Crash cleanup rejects live, foreign-owned, or ambiguous scratch directories.
subcase_contracts.A43.migration_diagnostic: Previously permitted persistent development overrides receive a redacted conflict report and the persistent setup path.
subcase_contracts.A30.instruction_contrast: Storage screens preserve contrast and match the redacted effective path report, including origins, inactive stores, and bootstrap authority.
subcase_contracts.A13.two_real_processes: Real processes race for lease ownership. Duplicate active instance identities refuse admission before committing shared state.
subcase_contracts.A44.canonical_alias_lookup: Starmap canonical and alias lookups return the same offering without copying unrelated provider models.
subcase_contracts.A44.caller_owned_values: Mutating a returned offering cannot change the retained immutable catalog or another caller result.
subcase_contracts.A44.exact_model_scaling: Recorded profiles show no full-provider copies or unrelated candidate enumeration as the number of unrelated routes grows.
subcase_contracts.A44.embedded_catalog_profile: Repeat the released embedded-catalog case and record time, bytes, allocations, and raw profiles for the changed artifact.
subcase_contracts.A44.precomputed_static_candidates: Activation constructs immutable endpoint and capability candidates. Warm exact selection does not rebuild them.
subcase_contracts.A44.auto_fallback_semantics: Broad auto selection, explicit fallbacks, aliases, ambiguous names, and current policy retain their declared behavior.
subcase_contracts.A44.generation_lease_consistency: Concurrent publication cannot mix route facts, pricing, or connector bindings in an existing request or stream.
subcase_contracts.A44.retained_generation_bounds: Update pressure respects the generation memory bound. Known withdrawals still fence affected new inference if activation cannot proceed.
subcase_contracts.A45.warm_no_derivation_or_io: Warm credential resolution performs zero key derivations, encrypted-record reads, and external secret reads.
subcase_contracts.A45.revision_owner_identity: Distinct owners, records, revisions, contracts, and encryption-key versions cannot share a material entry incorrectly.
subcase_contracts.A45.shared_grant_recheck: Shared material cannot serve an account after its required grant becomes invalid.
subcase_contracts.A45.rotation_expiry_revocation: Rotation, expiry, and revocation prevent old material use outside its explicit validity contract.
subcase_contracts.A45.revoked_refresh_fencing: An older in-flight refresh cannot restore material after revocation or a superseding version.
subcase_contracts.A45.cold_load_coalescing: Concurrent cold requests for one credential share bounded resolution work without blocking unrelated tenants.
subcase_contracts.A45.outage_validity: Refresh failure uses only still-valid material. Missing or expired material refuses without an ambient identity switch.
subcase_contracts.A45.resident_secret_bounds: Entries, secret bytes, refresh concurrency, and retention obey the profile under tenant churn.
subcase_contracts.A45.encryption_and_disclosure: Existing encryption strength remains intact. Catalogs, diagnostics, benchmark outputs, and response caches contain no plaintext material.
subcase_contracts.A46.warm_no_stable_store_reads: Warm valid key, account, team, and grant checks perform no KV or SQL reads for stable data.
subcase_contracts.A46.dependency_revision_coherence: A missing or incompatible dependency revision cannot activate as a complete authorization bundle.
subcase_contracts.A46.confirmed_absence_vs_unknown: Only an explicit verified absence can create a bounded negative entry. Failed reads cannot establish absent policy or budgets.
subcase_contracts.A46.local_mutation_fencing: A restrictive local mutation fences affected admission before reporting successful local activation.
subcase_contracts.A46.fleet_receipt_vs_enforcement: Durable mutation receipts remain distinct from confirmed enforcement on replicas.
subcase_contracts.A46.missed_event_catchup: Reconnect and event gaps recover revision state before expired or unknown authorization can serve requests.
subcase_contracts.A46.validity_skew_withdrawal: Expiry, clock skew, and known withdrawal preserve the declared maximum authorization delay and diagnostics.
subcase_contracts.A46.cache_retry_batch_admission: Cache delivery, retries, fallback, and queued work recheck the required current authorization.
subcase_contracts.A46.cold_load_deadline_coalescing: Cold loads coalesce per identity with explicit deadlines and bounded concurrent work.
subcase_contracts.A46.bounded_tenant_working_set: Tenant churn respects entry and byte limits without requiring all tenant records to remain resident.
subcase_contracts.A47.atomic_hierarchical_reservation: Real concurrent processes cannot overspend account, key, or team capacity through separate meter decisions.
subcase_contracts.A47.idempotent_attempt_identity: Repeated dispatch or recovery with one reservation identity cannot reserve or release capacity twice.
subcase_contracts.A47.bounded_cost_and_tokens: Dispatch requires a defensible cost and token bound with enforceable request limits.
subcase_contracts.A47.unknown_cost_refusal: Unknown required cost, units, policy, or capacity prevents upstream dispatch and produces the documented retryable or unsupported result.
subcase_contracts.A47.retry_fallback_charges: Retries and fallback preserve all potentially chargeable earlier attempts and reserve any additional required capacity.
subcase_contracts.A47.stream_cancel_uncertainty: Cancellation, EOF errors, and timeouts do not release capacity whose unused status remains uncertain.
subcase_contracts.A47.crash_failover_recovery: Crash and real backend failover preserve reservation identity or restrict admission until the missing interval is reconciled.
subcase_contracts.A47.usage_reconcile_once: Authoritative usage reconciles each reservation once and releases only established unused capacity.
subcase_contracts.A47.analytics_drop_independence: Dropped or delayed optional telemetry cannot increase available budget capacity.
subcase_contracts.A47.confirmed_absent_fast_path: Confirmed absent budgets perform no usage-total lookup while ordinary admission remains active.
subcase_contracts.A47.quota_lease_support_boundary: Local quota leases require prior capacity deduction, fencing, and safe expiry/recovery tests. Otherwise the supported mode rejects them explicitly.
subcase_contracts.A47.backend_operation_evidence: The profile records actual atomic operations, contention, and network round trips for each supported admission mode.
subcase_contracts.A48.bounded_cache_read_deadline: A slow optional cache stops affecting the request within the declared cache deadline, including cancellation behavior.
subcase_contracts.A48.nonblocking_fill_visibility: A successful answer does not wait for optional persistence or population barriers. Cache admission and visibility remain correct.
subcase_contracts.A48.fill_queue_byte_entry_bounds: Full queues drop optional fills within entry, byte, and concurrency bounds without dropping required accounting.
subcase_contracts.A48.worker_shutdown_ownership: Worker shutdown and cancellation are bounded. No unbounded goroutine growth or writes after owner close occur.
subcase_contracts.A48.stream_accumulation_bound: Accumulation stops at the configured byte or event bound before full-response encoding while delivery continues.
subcase_contracts.A48.stream_forwarding_errors: Long streams, slow clients, cancellation, partial errors, and usage frames preserve timely bounded forwarding.
subcase_contracts.A48.cache_semantic_mode_matrix: Disabled caches, hits, misses, oversized entries, expiry, outages, and opt-in semantic calls have separate measurements and cost reports.
subcase_contracts.A48.admission_and_expiry_preserved: All cache paths retain account scope, original expiry, generation identity, current permissions, and required budget checks.
subcase_contracts.A49.callback_no_remote_io: Inference callbacks perform no remote scans, reads, or publications for advisory health and latency.
subcase_contracts.A49.bounded_background_exchange: Peer exchange respects queue, byte, concurrency, interval, and timeout bounds under shared-store failure.
subcase_contracts.A49.local_breaker_immediacy: Local breaker admission and half-open decisions remain immediate and preserve their concurrency contract.
subcase_contracts.A49.stale_hint_expiry: Missing or stale peer hints follow the documented advisory behavior without extending authorization validity.
subcase_contracts.A49.cold_peer_refresh: The first request does not perform peer synchronization. Startup and background refresh have separate measurements.
subcase_contracts.A49.worker_close_and_reconnect: Shutdown, reconnect, and repeated failure do not leak workers or duplicate unbounded refresh work.
subcase_contracts.A49.fleet_fault_isolation: Slow peer storage does not stall unrelated inference or change required authority and budget admission.
subcase_contracts.A50.full_path_baseline: Before optimization, capture a failing or unqualified full HTTP baseline that includes middleware, decoding, routing, credentials, and encoding.
subcase_contracts.A50.reviewed_numeric_profile: The versioned profile supplies reviewed numeric limits and workload, resource, validity, and environment definitions before dependent optimizations.
subcase_contracts.A50.gateway_provider_boundaries: Controlled upstream tests separate gateway processing, connector codecs, connection work, provider wait, and client backpressure without subtracting whole connector calls.
subcase_contracts.A50.percentiles_and_load: Report p50, p95, p99, and p99.9 with offered load, concurrency, sample counts, duration, repeated runs, and uncertainty.
subcase_contracts.A50.stream_timing_memory: First byte, first token, event forwarding, completion, cancellation, and long-stream memory meet the declared profile.
subcase_contracts.A50.allocations_cpu_gc: Record allocations and bytes per request/event, CPU, GC, live heap, RSS, queues, and retained generations.
subcase_contracts.A50.real_recipe_matrix: Actual local and fleet backends pass warm/cold, cache-miss, tenant-diversity, large-input, retry, refresh, outage, and saturation profiles.
subcase_contracts.A50.connection_reuse_lifecycle: Pooling and supported HTTP/2 remain correct under saturation, reconnects, and runtime generation changes.
subcase_contracts.A50.partial_complete_metric_surfaces: Headers, usage, API, and UI identify timing scope, precision, and sample windows. Partial metrics cannot claim complete overhead.
subcase_contracts.A50.current_artifact_evidence: Candidate and shipped results bind exact artifacts and catalog identity. Changed bytes or behavior invalidate affected evidence.
subcase_contracts.A28.applied_config_memory: Requests use the applied configuration revision without rereading files or shared SQL. UI diagnostics distinguish that state from policy validity.
subcase_contracts.A31.recipe_latency_profile: Each supported recipe explains memory-serving state, durable owners, strict admission operations, and its qualified latency profile.
subcase_contracts.A34.qualified_performance_claims: README performance claims link exact artifacts, complete timing boundaries, and qualified workloads. Early documentation qualifies or removes unsupported claims.
subcase_contracts.A38.inference_real_speed: The inference scene preserves real timing. Disclosed cuts elsewhere do not imply a latency result.
subcase_contracts.A32.cli_effective_report: The standalone CLI reports effective configuration, schema, paths, presence, and redacted origins from the shared descriptors.
subcase_contracts.A32.admin_effective_report: The authenticated Starmap administrative API matches the CLI report, including before catalog acceptance. Subscriber credentials receive denial.
subcase_contracts.A33.fresh_replica_history_barrier: A fresh gateway refuses admission when the approved KV incarnation or recovery epoch differs, even if restored records look valid.
subcase_contracts.A33.old_primary_admission_fence: Recovery cannot reopen until old gateways and the former KV primary cannot admit or dispatch affected work.
subcase_contracts.A33.restart_and_recovery_epoch: KV restart, promotion, rollback, and SQL witness recovery require validated history continuity or restricted reconciliation before a new epoch opens.
subcase_contracts.A47.chargeable_operation_matrix: Every supported paid operation and internal invocation maps to reservation before dispatch, with evidence for its billing units.
subcase_contracts.A47.recognition_then_cancel: Concurrent document recognition reserves the selected offering cost. Cancellation before chat preserves incurred and uncertain recognition charges.
subcase_contracts.A47.rerank_billing_units: Multi-unit and token-priced reranking reserves a defensible bound or refuses before provider dispatch.
subcase_contracts.A47.semantic_embedding_cache_hit: A paid semantic embedding reserves independently even when it finds a cached response. Free cache delivery invents no provider charge.
subcase_contracts.A47.media_async_reconciliation: Supported moderation, image, audio, video, and asynchronous jobs preserve per-operation reservations and reconcile late usage once.
subcase_contracts.A47.utc_window_boundaries: Admission binds fixed UTC day, ISO week, and month identities. Retries across boundaries reserve in their own admission windows.
subcase_contracts.A47.late_usage_pinned_valuation: Late usage reconciles the original reservation windows and pinned nano-USD pricing, with explicit rounding and uncertain capacity retention.
subcase_contracts.A47.policy_edit_preserves_spend: Limit, membership, and policy revisions do not erase accumulated spend or change the meter identities of existing reservations.
subcase_contracts.A47.clock_and_window_authority: Concurrent replicas use the declared admission clock and skew bound. Unknown time validity refuses strict admission.
subcase_contracts.A47.reconciliation_retention: Duplicate or late usage cannot release capacity after deduplication evidence expires. Unknown reconciliation remains restricted.
